title: Tasnawit tazrfan
lead: Nadi deg isnilsen izrfanen yettwasɣnen (izrefen, isemgar, tiddin, tizrawin). Yal asnils yettwaskan s uɣbalu-s, aɣbalu yettwasentmen yemgarad ɣef wiyaḍ.
searchPh: Nadi s umagrad, asentem neɣ yismawen…
pendingBody: Tasantut tummidt (anadi, imsadaden, uskan) tettewjed, maca ulac asnils azrfan yettwasɣnen yettwarna. Ulac agmuḍ ara yettwaskan alamma llan yiɣbula imadduden. Ulac agbur azrfan ara yettwaxleq.
sourcesLead: Tabdart n yiɣbula. Addad n usentem yebna ɣef usenqed amezrayan n usɣun.
unverifiedWarn: ⚠️ Aɣbalu war asentem — ɛned ɣef uḍris amaddud send asemres.
disclaimer: Agbur-a mačči d aḍris amaddud, ur yeqqil ara ɣef Uɣmis Amaddud.
